sources.title: Modern Warfare 2 has no dedicated servers
No Dedicated Servers for Modern Warfare 2 PC
Call of Duty PC gamers peeved as dedicated servers ditched
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (AppID 10180) - SteamDB
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009) - Multiplayer (AppID 10190) - SteamDB

notes: No command channel exists for this title. Infinity Ward removed dedicated servers from the PC version before launch and replaced them with IWNet peer-to-peer matchmaking: no server browser, no LAN, no server binary. bit-tech (Oct 2009) quotes Infinity Ward's Robert Bowling directly: 'You are completely reliant on IW.NET. There are no server lists. There are no dedicated servers.' The Escapist quotes Bowling on cross-platform parity as the rationale, and The Register reports the IWNet replacement without quoting him; the three outlets agree on the fact, only bit-tech carries that quote. Steam ships only the game (10180) and its multiplayer component (10190, 'Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009) - Multiplayer', app type Game); there is no '- Dedicated Server' tool app, in contrast to Modern Warfare 3, which has one (42750, app type Tool). No later re-release restored dedicated servers. A match is hosted by a player's client, so there is no console, no RCON and no admin API to reach. RIFT//CTRL should drop straight to the host-level floor. Caveat, deliberately NOT recorded as this game's transport: third-party clients that re-add dedicated servers to MW2 (AlterIWnet, IW4x, Plutonium IW4) do speak the Quake3-style UDP rcon used by the rest of the Call of Duty line. IW4M-Admin's IW4x parser sends 'clientkick {num} "{reason}"', 'tempbanclient {num} "{reason}"' and 'sayraw {message}' on default rcon port 28960, and B3's cod6 parser sends 'clientkick', 'unbanuser' and 'say'. Those are mod clients, not Activision's product, so they do not make retail MW2 commandable; if a user is actually running IW4x, treat it as a separate target. If the 2022 title 'Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II' was meant instead, the answer is the same: it also ships no dedicated server and no admin console.
